role: natural multi-needle long-context replication of the adaptive layer-quota contrast
prerequisites: terminal digest-bound nine-seed P2 causal audit
terminal Qwen3-4B adaptive-quota RULER audit regardless of outcome
terminal baseline Qwen3-4B MRCR audit regardless of outcome
verified frozen MRCR dataset, scorer, model, and fixed-baseline selection
execution_policy: run all 1500 frozen examples under both arms; prerequisite outcomes never select, cancel, truncate, or reorder needle counts, token bins, or examples

benchmark.name: MRCR
benchmark.generation_reserve_rule: ground-truth answer token count plus 32 tokens
benchmark.paired_unit: the same frozen example with identical rendered prompt and exact context/question token ids
benchmark.overflow_policy: retain unsupported-context as an intention-to-evaluate failure scored zero; never truncate
benchmark.reporting: report all 15 frozen needle-count by token-bin cells; no pooled shorter-bin result may hide 64K-128K failure

natural-adaptive-quota+pins.layer_signal: normalized entropy concentration of z-scored current-layer scorer values
natural-adaptive-quota+pins.causal_prior: running mean of earlier-layer concentrations only

scorer_selection.rule: reuse the frozen score-compatible Qwen selection without MRCR outcome inspection

cache_lifecycle_contract.final_query_tokens: append identically after context compression without adaptive reallocation
cache_lifecycle_contract.generation_tokens: decode identically under the arm-specific post-prefill cache
per_successful_example_audit: all 36 initial layer allocations in causal order
configured and observed initial total kept tokens
score concentration and controller time per layer
initial hot-resident bytes, peak HBM, and end-to-end latency

statistics.failure_policy: intention-to-evaluate; every allowed operational or unsupported-context failure scores zero and is never dropped or silently retried

failure_reporting.paired_scoring_policy: retain every frozen example and score allowed failures zero

claim_boundary: A passing result supports bounded transfer of the initial causal layer-quota heuristic to frozen 2/4/8-needle MRCR retrieval through 128K on one Qwen3-4B checkpoint. It does not establish continuous adaptive reallocation, arbitrary open-ended reasoning quality, cross-model transfer, contexts beyond 128K, or official DeepSeek-V4 behavior.
